subject: The toolkit's own documents have no currency watches
recordedOccasion: from a session-management bundle that decided this and should not have.
severity: moderate. Eleven references and five architecture records describe machinery that changes without them, and one — `master-directory-reference.md` — is cited by 31 documents, so a stale one misleads broadly.
scope: the toolkit set. The watches live in `.internal/ai-scripts/session-management/doc-currency.json`, but which of the toolkit's documents earn one is `.github/toolkit-instructions.md`'s to decide.
read: all eleven `references/*.md`, opened one at a time
the five unwatched architecture records and `docs/ledgers/evidence-conformance.md`
inbound citation counts for each, across every tracked Markdown file

members.statement: Eleven reference documents describe machinery that changes without them, and none is watched
members.sectionHeading: F1 — the references describe the machinery and nothing watches them

members.statement: Four architecture records and one ledger describe toolkit machinery and are unwatched
members.sectionHeading: F2 — the architecture records and one ledger

members.statement: Whether a document goes stale was tested by what it names, and the relationship runs the other way
members.sectionHeading: F3 — the test was run in the wrong direction
